doc_friction.issue: Step 0 sends every run to the security queue, whose top entries (#7, #42, #43 in risk_review.py; #68-#93 usage.mjs; js/double-escaping) are already-fixed code CodeQL still flags, as docs/reports/2026-11-24-codeql-backlog-cleared.md records. The queue (about 1,180 alerts) cannot tell a run which alerts are known false positives, so each run re-triages them. A known-false-positive list read by security_alerts.py would save that time.
Monitor's schema must be loaded with ToolSearch before its first call; a bare `sleep N; cmd` is blocked. Use run_in_background with an until-loop instead.

notes: Security queue: top alert #7 (py/clear-text-storage-sensitive-data, platform/security/risk_review.py:457) and its siblings #42 and #43 are false positives. risk_review.py prints only the file path and the secret pattern's name (find_secrets returns (path, name)), never the matched value. No code changed; the owner can dismiss them. Also checked: the js/double-escaping entries decode & last, which is the correct order (FP). The usage.mjs entries are the countsOnly counter (FP, documented in the file). Metric: writing/search.json size fetched on the first keystroke of the blog search. Before: 6,703,979 B gzip, 18,320,419 B raw. After: 2,454,970 B gzip, 6,076,025 B raw. Both taken as Chromium responseBodySize from a local gzip server over two full builds (node platform/pages/build.mjs) on the same tree, before and after the change. Keystroke to results (Playwright, 150 ms RTT, 1.6 Mbit/s): 39.6 s before, 18.2 s after, same counts (26, 4, 0 of 7,348). JSON.parse: 121 ms before, 17 ms after. Equivalence: 0 mismatches over 21 terms on the real corpus. writing.test.mjs: 60/60. Construction front doors for bet #1 measured at 18-55 kB: nothing to fix there.

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
